description: Which remaining-time label a lit lamp carries. The kind is shared; each platform renders it with its own localized copy (Vietnamese: "Còn {days} ngày", "Còn dưới 1 ngày").

inputs.remaining_seconds: end moment minus the current moment, in seconds (may be zero or negative)

output.days: present when kind is days: remaining time in days rounded up, 1 or more

cases.name: a fresh 7-day lamp shows 7 days
cases.source: BR-LMP-12 (whole days rounded up; under 24 hours is its own label)

cases.name: a fresh 49-day lamp shows 49 days
cases.source: BR-LMP-12 (whole days rounded up; under 24 hours is its own label)
